source.notes: Scanned 1-page paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page image. Header prints '2nd INTERIM TEST, 2022 -2023', 'CLASS 7', 'BIOLOGY', 'TIME : 40 MIN.', 'MARKS 20.'; examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed academic year (the file name also ends 080823-2023). No school name printed. Section A: Q.1 fill in the blanks (3, split into its three items at 1 mark each), Q.2 match the column (3, kept together because the items share one column of answers), Q.3 examples (3, two items that would get 1½ marks each, so kept together). Section B: Q.4 (6), Q.5 (2½), Q.6 (2½); the half marks are recorded rounded up to 3 because the format takes whole marks, so the pack total is 21 against the printed 20. The paper's own spellings ('hype', 'Nitrobactor', 'Bacillusanthracite', 'Penincilin', 'arced', '2-2 example') are kept as printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
